correctness.rationale: Mandatory nonoverlined copies yield an exact reversible multivariate deletion bijection. Sills–Engel quantitative overpartition-count asymptotics give a uniform ratio at shifts O(sqrt(N)) and imply the joint Rayleigh running-minimum limit. Exact coincidence counts are sums of coefficient differences, with locally uniform error O(N^(-1/2)) per term on an O(N^(1/4)) window, a Riemann-sum limit r/s and Rayleigh tail control. Direct enumeration through weight 12 checks the exact identities but does not establish the infinite theorem.
